title: Hybrid LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agents for Complex Sequential Decision Tasks
title_zh: 面向复杂序列决策任务的 Hybrid LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agents
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool-use, enabling new forms of autonomous agents. However, LLM-based agents struggle with long-horizon sequential decision tasks that require precise action optimization and environment interaction. Reinforcement Learning (RL), while effective for sequential control, often lacks the high-level abstraction and task decomposition abilities needed for complex scenarios. This paper introduces an LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent that integrates LLM-driven planning with RL-based action optimization. The proposed architecture leverages the LLM to generate subgoals, structured plans, and contextual guidance, while the RL agent refines low-level actions through interaction with the environment. Experiments on sequential decision tasks demonstrate improved sample efficiency, higher success rates, and more coherent action trajectories compared to RL-only and LLM-only baselines. This hybrid paradigm highlights a promising direction for building more capable autonomous systems.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种 LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent，将 Large Language Models（LLMs）的高层推理、规划与任务分解能力，和 Reinforcement Learning（RL）的低层动作优化与环境交互能力结合起来。该架构由 LLM 生成子目标、结构化计划和上下文指导，再由 RL agent 通过与环境交互细化具体动作。实验表明，在复杂序列决策任务中，相比 RL-only 与 LLM-only 基线，该混合范式能提升样本效率、任务成功率，并产生更连贯的动作轨迹，展示了构建更强自主智能体的潜力。
key_points_zh: 针对 LLM-based agents 在长程序列决策中动作精度不足、RL 缺乏高层抽象的问题，提出混合式 LLM+RL 架构。
LLM 负责生成 subgoals、structured plans 与 contextual guidance，为复杂任务提供高层分解和规划。
RL agent 负责在环境交互中优化低层动作，使计划能够转化为可执行且更精确的行为序列。
实验显示该方法相较 RL-only 和 LLM-only baselines 具有更高 sample efficiency、success rate 和更连贯的 action trajectories。
论文强调 LLM-driven planning 与 RL-based action optimization 的互补性，为复杂 autonomous agents 提供了可扩展方向。

llm_assessment.comment: The hybrid LLM-plus-RL idea is plausible but remains generic sequential-decision work without a clear reusable agent harness or trajectory-improvement infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: LLM 与 RL 结合的思路合理，但整体仍偏通用序贯决策，缺少明确可复用的智能体框架或轨迹改进基础设施。
